anchors.description: Height of the open white six-panel interior door leaf in the cased opening between the living/dining area and the kitchen, measured from its top edge (under the head casing) to its bottom edge at the threshold.
anchors.visible_evidence: A white six-panel hinged door stands open in the kitchen doorway; its top edge is visible just below the white head casing and its bottom edge meets the threshold at the kitchen floor, with the door knob (standard height, near mid-leaf) and four recessed panels confirming a full-size leaf rather than a half-door.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US residential interior door leaf, nominally 6 ft 8 in (2.032 m); head/threshold clearances and the casing occluding a few pixels of the top edge give about +/-3 cm; no size or brand marking is readable.
